The shuffle test asserted the result is never equal to the input, but
a correct Fisher-Yates shuffle can (rarely, ~1/720 for 6 elements)
return the identity permutation. Stub Math.random for a deterministic
result, and sort numerically instead of relying on default
lexicographic sort.
